business_summary: India's largest private life insurer by AUM (~Rs4+ lakh cr, model estimate), majority-owned by SBI (~55%, model) with BNP Paribas Cardif as a minority partner. Sells savings (non-par, par, ULIP), protection (credit life, group term) and annuity products mostly through SBI branches (bancassurance) plus agency and brokers. Q2 FY27 PAT Rs549cr (+11% YoY), APE ~Rs6,390cr (+8%), VNB Rs1,860cr (+12%), VNB margin 29.1% (PL, 2026-10-28). Stock Rs1,735 (-12% in 12m); IRDAI commission-cap draft is the main overhang but SBI Life is described as least affected.

revenue_mix.segment: protection incl. credit life and group term

exposures.mechanism: IRDAI draft (comments closed 2026-10-25; may apply from FY28/January) caps product commissions. SBI Life is said to be within proposed caps and credit-life (high commission) attachment <50% (ET BFSI, 2026-10-29): VNB at risk ~-2 to -3% vs -3 to -6% for HDFC Life; capitalised at ~2.5x EV-style multiple (P/EV ~2.4, model) => ~-2.5; range up to +2 since lower distributor payout benefits a captive-bank insurer's margin and rivals lose share. Stock fell 6-7% on 2026-09-24 (headline). Systematix says IRDAI may soften the cap.

evidence.note: IRDAI exposure draft (2026-09-23/24): product-wise commission caps and 5-year expense limits from FY28; comments to 2026-10-25; PB Fintech -36% in a day, insurers -7 to -26% (ET/NDTV Profit/Reuters)

exposures.mechanism: +25bp: new non-par guaranteed products price higher (VNB margin +20bp ~ +0.7% VNB) and reinvestment yield up; offsets MTM on non-par/shareholder debt and a ~2.4x P/EV discount-rate effect => ~+0.3, low confidence.
+25bp repo (hiked to 5.50% on 2026-10-07) -> bank FDs +20-30bp -> competes with non-par savings (~40% of APE) -> -1.5% savings volume x margin ~30% => -0.5.

evidence.note: RBI MPC hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening' (Hindu/Reuters/CNBC TV18 headlines)

exposures.mechanism: +10% SIP/DII flows -> equity market support -> ULIP (~25-30% of APE) and fee AUM: AUM +1% -> EBITDA +0.4% => +0.8. DII ownership is high in insurers.
+$5bn/qtr FPI inflow: SBI Life is a Nifty 50 constituent with high FII ownership; market beta 0.85-0.9 (pack) so index move of ~3% => +2.5.
+1 structural shift of savings to financial products raises protection/annuity penetration: APE growth +2pp pa => VNB +3% x persistence 1.0 => +3.
+1pp GDP -> disposable income +1.2pp -> APE +1.5pp, lower lapses => VNB +2.5% x persistence 0.8 => +2.0.
+5 VIX points -> equity-market fall -> ULIP sales and fee AUM slip, plus index de-rating; beta 0.85 (pack).
+1pp CPI -> real income squeeze and higher rates; expense inflation ~+0.2% on opex; net -0.6.

+1 (higher) capital-gains tax lowers equity-market valuations and ULIP attractiveness; FM said she is open to views on LTCG/STT (2026-10-13), so a cut is the live direction (positive for the stock; sign flips) => central -0.8 for the risk of a rise.

evidence.note: FM Sitharaman open to stakeholder views on LTCG and STT (Kotak Neo/UNI); no formal review announced

exposures.mechanism: Pack elasticity -0.69 per +10% (t -1.8) is only marginally significant; mechanism = oil -> CPI -> yields/market risk. Central -0.3 after shrinking toward zero.

company_links.mechanism: w = % change in SBILIFE equity per +1% in SBIN equity. SBIN owns ~55% (model) and its branches originate the majority of individual APE (model estimate ~60%+); SBIN sentiment/policy stance (PSU bank distribution mandates) feeds through at ~0.15.
